Class GameSession

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.model.GameSession
public final class GameSession extends Object
Owns one round of snake, food, walls, and effects; reset recreates its mutable state.

    • GameSession

      public GameSession(Game game)
      Creates a round without a preset level.
      Parameters:

    • GameSession

      public GameSession(Game game, Level level)
      Creates a round and loads its preset walls when a level is supplied.
      Parameters:
      game - the game rules and score
      level - the selected level, or null for a game without a preset level
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if game is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if game dimensions differ from the level
